name: Dunkin' Egg & Cheese Wake-Up Wrap (Plain, No Meat)
whyItWorks: Warm small soft flour tortilla folded around a fluffy egg patty and melted American cheese. Small portion size (under 200 calories) that avoids heavy stomach distension on road trips.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order: 'Egg & Cheese Wake-Up Wrap plain—NO bacon, NO sausage.' Order two if you need more protein.
